g.text: Lifecycle: from YAML to run results

text.tspan: discover YAML, record file, line, column
bind refs and sources, defaults, naming, selectors
errors: PLP, PLC, PLK (L4 to L6); PLF with --preflight
fuse ephemeral models into units, freeze
scheduler runs units through an executor
errors: PLX, PLM, PLQ, PLE, PLU
merge invocation results, commit run state,
run record in the state store
each stage is a pure function of the previous output
and emits events to the bus
